definitions.gloss: fish paste; surimi; ground fish meat
definitions.explanation: minced or ground fish paste used as a base ingredient for various processed seafood products like kamaboko, chikuwa, and imitation crab

examples.japanese: すり{身|み}で{団子|だんご}を{作|つく}る。
カニカマはすり{身|み}から{作|つく}られる。
examples.english: Imitation crab is made from surimi.

examples.japanese: {新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな}をすり{身|み}にする。

notes:
FOOD TERM:
すり{身|み} is the base ingredient for many traditional Japanese fish products. The word has been adopted internationally as 'surimi.'

PRODUCTS MADE FROM すり{身|み}:
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ} - kamaboko (fish cake)
- ちくわ - chikuwa (tube-shaped fish cake)
- さつま{揚|あ}げ - satsuma-age (fried fish cake)
- カニカマ - imitation crab
- {魚肉|ぎょにく}ソーセージ - fish sausage
- はんぺん - hanpen (white fish cake)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すり{身|み}にする - to grind into paste
- {魚|さかな}のすり{身|み} - fish paste
- {白身|しろみ}{魚|ざかな}のすり{身|み} - white fish surimi

PROCESS:
{魚|さかな}の{身|み}をすりつぶす → washing → mixing → shaping
